question.problem: Rounded to $2$ decimal places, what is the value of $2\log(7) + 5\log(5)?$
question.worked_solution:
We compute the required expression to $2$ decimal places using a calculator, rounding the intermediate steps to $5$ decimal places to avoid rounding error. This gives

$$
\begin{aligned}2\operatorname{log}⁡(7)+5\operatorname{log}⁡(5) & ≈2(0.845\,10)+5(0.698\,97) \\  & =1.690\,20+3.494\,85 \\  & =5.185\,05 \\  & ≈5.19.\end{aligned}
$$
